CustomObject.description: One evolving row per customer, written by CsatRatingSaver from Experience Rating's own sentiment read of the conversation, read by Risk Detection before it hands off to Refund. Has_Open_Context__c is the "case == 1 / case == 0" signal: true only while there is a recent, genuine negative sentiment on file. Mock data for this project; there is no real Pronto sentiment feed (D-083).
CustomObject.label: CARES Customer Context
